angular_protocol.scope: Models frozen before reading new-direction slope RGB. Selection may use visible geometry and exact identity, never residual.
angular_protocol.input: Already admitted material palette: measured left L, top T, right R. For unadmitted colors report measurements but no model-score substitution from nominal LDraw RGB.
angular_protocol.axes: Inclination from horizontal. Reference visible-left slope normal=(sin(theta),-cos(theta),0); visible-right=(0,-cos(theta),sin(theta)).

models.baseline: Current abs(normal)-weighted convex blend of axial colors.
models.piecewise_angle: Linear RGB interpolation between the two adjacent angular knots; clip each knot before interpolation.
models.piecewise_cone: Positive cone weights for adjacent unit normal rays: sin(theta_b-theta), sin(theta-theta_a); normalize their sum, blend clipped knot RGB.
models.global_polynomial: Per-channel Lagrange polynomial through all directional knots in theta, then clip0..255; left cubic/right quadratic. Exploratory alternative, not presumed physical.

angular_protocol.evaluation: All9fixed ROI shifts; MAE<=3 and maxchannel<=10 at every shift. Compare on exactly the same admitted sources and keep all failures. Allthree rules fixed here; choosing best after this study requires a later holdout before claiming independent validation.
angular_protocol.runtime: No change before checking additional directions.

limits: Numeric summaries only; no official source pixels or fonts bundled.
Image duplicates excluded, but different decoded hashes need not represent independent rendering jobs.
The two18degree sources confound material and orientation; not a matched orientation experiment.
Four models fixed before new RGB. None is promoted to the runtime.
Nominal LDraw RGB is not substituted for missing measured palette entries.
